Read `AGENTS.md` and the README before proposing changes.

LaraSaaS 3.x is a Laravel Composer library. Production plans are admin-managed database records; config defines only typed feature capabilities and display/integration settings. Do not confuse paid plan entitlements with Pennant rollout flags, or the Next.js demo with the package backend.

Keep pricing public, billing private, admin Gate-protected, and all embed writes signed. Preserve archived subscription price mappings. Ship the LaraSaaS baseline migration plus the optional multi-tenant workspace migration, all tables/columns directly defined; there is no legacy/additive upgrade path for the unused schema. Migrations target the CONFIGURED model's table (larasaas.user_model / workspace model) — never a hardcoded `users` table — and larasaas:doctor alerts when the config model changes after migrating. multi_tenant.enabled is the single-/multi-tenant switch (workspaces, Owner/Admin/Member roles, e-mail invitations); off means no workspace surface at all. Never overwrite host migrations or seed demo plans. Native dashboards call createPlan/updatePlan/archivePlan after host authorization; the optional admin controller shares that validation. Embeds are customer-facing only. Run the PHP compatibility matrix and shipped React typecheck, and document breaking changes and migration steps.
